correctness.rationale: The explicit GF(2) incidence identity and the cube group-algebra model prove F^3=0 and rank F=N-2; the independent calculation dim(sI)=2^(d-1)-1 with all-ones j in sI proves rank F^2=N/2-2. These exact ranks force the complete nilpotent Jordan partition and extinction counts. Direct binary adjacency checks independently verified ranks and zero third power for dimensions 2 through 8; exhaustive initial states were checked at d=2 and d=3. Boundary d=1 treated separately. No finite experiment is used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: A canonical graph family motivated by existing adjacency-code investigations receives an exact second-image filtration, full Jordan classification, sharp extinction cutoff and dimension-dependent final-step probability. The dimension-independent count of exactly two length-two Jordan blocks is a structural invariant not supplied by code rank. These are complete infinite-family dynamical invariants, not ad hoc numerical slices.
